title: Sell Mineral Rights in Millerton, PA
metaTitle: Sell Mineral Rights in Millerton, PA | Tioga County
metaDescription: Millerton, PA sits near the New York line in Tioga County's dry-gas Marcellus fairway. We buy mineral rights directly, no listing, no waiting.
heroLead: Millerton sits so close to the New York state line that some Tioga County families here have relatives just across the border who never got the chance to lease their own land, since New York never allowed the same kind of Marcellus development.
intro: That contrast has made a real difference for families around Millerton. Tioga County has been part of Pennsylvania's dry-gas Marcellus core for over a decade, with operators developing large multi-well pads across Jackson and neighboring townships, while ground just a few miles north across the state line has stayed untouched.
We buy mineral and royalty interests around Millerton directly. If your family's land sits on the Pennsylvania side of that line, we'll help you understand exactly what your interest is worth.

sections.heading: Tioga County's Dry-Gas Fairway
paragraphs: The rock under Tioga County is considered some of the best dry-gas Marcellus in the play, thick and consistently productive across a wide area. That quality is part of why operators kept developing here even as gas prices moved through several down cycles over the years.

Production around Millerton has generally followed the typical Marcellus pattern: a strong initial flow followed by a steep first-year decline, then a longer, steadier tail that can continue for many years.

sections.heading: Border-Area Title Considerations
paragraphs: Families with land near the New York line sometimes hold deeds with older surveys that predate modern parcel mapping, since this area wasn't always a priority for updated county records. We research your title through the Tioga County Recorder of Deeds in Wellsboro and take the time to reconcile older boundary descriptions with current unit maps.
If your deed references a boundary by an old landmark rather than a modern survey point, that's not unusual here and doesn't prevent a clean transfer.

sections.heading: What We'll Walk You Through
paragraphs: Before any offer, we'll go over your division order, recent royalty history, and lease terms with you so you understand exactly what you own and what's shaping its value.

faqs.question: Why hasn't gas been developed on the New York side of the border?
faqs.answer: New York has restricted high-volume hydraulic fracturing, so Marcellus development largely stopped at the state line, which is part of why the contrast with Pennsylvania land near Millerton is so stark.

faqs.question: My deed uses an old-style boundary description. Is that a problem?
faqs.answer: It can slow title research slightly, but it's common in this part of Tioga County and not a barrier to a clean transfer once we reconcile it against current records.

faqs.question: How does a long production decline affect what you'll offer?
faqs.answer: We evaluate based on where the well currently sits in its decline curve and recent trailing royalty history, not only how strong production was in the first year.
